title: Assistant, Parrot, or Colonizing Loudspeaker? ChatGPT Metaphors for Developing Critical AI Literacies

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation through collaborative autoethnography and thematic analysis of metaphors like 'colonizing loudspeaker' and 'western museum' to reflect on how AI training datasets reproduce and amplify white Western epistemologies and colonial viewpoints.

Reflective discussion and autoethnographic analysis of the 'leveling the playing field' metaphor to examine the systemic disadvantages faced by multilingual speakers and non-native English students compared to native speakers navigating Standard American English norms.

Theoretical reflection mapping metaphors against the historical power dynamics of 'essayist literacy' and coding literacy, examining class anxieties and the potential downward mobility of the middle class due to automated systems.
Categorizing and reflecting on gendered metaphors such as the 'mansplainer' within a multiliteracies heuristic framework to critically examine the behavioral perceptions of Large Language Models.
